## Our Values

- ### You Thrive with Ambition





You’re motivated by ambition and strive for exceptional results. You love to grow professionally and personally. You demand greatness from yourself and others.

- ### You Strive For Impact Through Pragmatism





Execution is key: you get stuff done and relentlessly pursue impactful outcomes. You meet problems with pragmatic solutions to create impact for customers and stakeholders. You stay flexible and proactive as priorities shift and the company grows.

- ### You Are Passionate and Honest





You celebrate wins enthusiastically, and share mistakes as fuel for growth. You give colleagues honest feedback, challenge them constructively, because you respect them. You proactively share knowledge and foster a culture of teamwork.


![](https://images.teamtailor-cdn.com/images/s3/teamtailor-production/user_picture_1200-v8/image_uploads/f231534f-e105-4a95-ba66-8f4dc0948213/original.jpeg)

## WHO WE ARE

**Formalize is a tech company founded in 2021 and one of the fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups.**

We started the company with our Whistleblower Software, but have since expanded our portfolio with our GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance) software, called Formalize.

We are highly dedicated, passionate, and always ready to learn from each other. We foster an international and dynamic workplace, where diverse perspectives pave the way for great ideas. We are a team of 200+ people from 30+ different nationalities operating in multiple European markets. We believe that an exceptional workplace comes from a team of exceptional colleagues.

Read more about us here: [About Formalize](https://career.formalize.com/pages/about-formalize)

## FAQs

- ### What is the Whistleblower Software Product?







**The software that started the company.** Late 2019 the EU decided to pass the Whistleblower Protection Directive to protect employees who want to report unlawful behaviour. Whistleblower Software soon became the highest-rated whistleblowing platform on the market, according to users on software rating platform G2. The software allows organizations to easily customize reporting page and manage whistleblowing cases while giving employees a secure way to submit their reports confidentially or anonymously. Whistleblower Software has the highest level of security backed by certifications, metadata removal and end-to-end encryption. Some of the most popular features are two-way communication with whistleblowers, customizability, unlimited cases, users and 70+ languages supported. The software is designed for ease of use and aligns with legal whistleblowing standards across the world.

- ### What is the Formalize Product?







**The software that has taken the company to new heights.** Formalize is a compliance operations platform that helps companies to enhance their compliance and simplify the workload. Formalize streamlines tasks like data governance, risk management, audits, and much more across various regulations and standards (e.g., DORA, NIS2, ISO 27001, and more). Some of the features include dashboard reporting, supplier audit automations, risk management module, and customizable workflows, helping businesses efficiently meet regulatory requirements and maintain secure compliance processes.

- ### Possibility of working part-time?







We currently have several part-timers in the organization and will continue to have so in the future. Typically these positions will be for our different departments in Legal, Marketing, People, Product, Customer Success, and Finance.
